verdict.rationale: WooCommerce's REST API and WC-CLI (woocommerce-docs-11,13,27,44) support bulk create/read/update/delete of products, and migration guides (woocommerce-docs-15,30,38) imply bulk data transfer, but the evidence pack never mentions the built-in CSV import/export tool that ops teams typically use for spreadsheet-based bulk edits. missing for 10: explicit documentation of CSV product import/export UI, batch-size limits/performance for large catalogs, and independent hands-on confirmation of bulk-edit workflows.
